title: Trading bot bullwhip (Kalshi case, compressed)
scenario: A crypto trading agent treats a series of weak, repeated market signals as strong actionable commands, sizes up the same-direction trade each time, and the loss compounds at every step. This is a condensed slice of the real $2000 -> $396 drawdown incident.

raw_events.input: BTC flat, same weak signal re-read

input.expected_behavior: Stop trading after the first losing position; never size up on a weak, repeated signal

what_to_notice: The Amplification Path section shows WHERE it started (a minor input signal treated as actionable) and how output variance grew across the layer boundaries it crossed. The Counterfactual line states what would stay unattributed without the diagnosis -- it does NOT claim the tool would have prevented the loss. Diagnostic Completeness tells you how much to trust this read given the inputs.
